exposure: uterine arterial embolism (UAE) + ultrasound guided uterine evacuation
Group A2: UAE + ultrasound-guided uterine evacuation
Group A3: HIFU + ultrasound-guided uterine evacuation
high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) + ultrasound guided uterine evacuation
cohort: 134 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy at the Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University
finding: Ultrasound-guided uterine curettage can be an effective treatment for Cesarean scar pregnancy, and UAE or HIFU before curettage can reduce uterine bleeding.
